tagline: Walk one hop in a graph
description: Look up an entity in a Graph knowledge base (by name or id) and return every relation touching it, each with the entity on the far side — one hop of graph traversal. Filter by direction or relation type. Wire a Knowledge Base node into knowledge_base, same as the search nodes.

inputs.name: entity
inputs.description: The entity to look up — its name (case-insensitive) or id.

inputs.name: knowledge_base
inputs.description: The knowledge base to traverse, from a Knowledge Base node. If omitted, falls back to the flow's default knowledge base.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Which relations to include: both, out (entity is the source), or in (entity is the target).

inputs.name: relation_type
inputs.description: Optional: only relations of this type (e.g. works_at). Case-insensitive.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: Maximum number of neighbors to return

outputs.name: entity
outputs.description: The resolved entity row (null if not found)

outputs.name: neighbors
outputs.description: Relations touching the entity: { edge_id, relation_type, description, direction, node }

outputs.name: error
outputs.description: Error message if it failed (including entity not found)
